items.item: The page header has a plural title ("Stock movements") and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 "Lịch sử xuất nhập kho" (movement history; Vietnamese has no plural form, noun phrase names the collection). One primary: #btnCreate (bg-blue-700) "Tạo phiếu"; #btnExport "Xuất Excel" is outlined secondary; audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The movements table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (movement type, warehouse, date range) and no decorative hero above it
items.evidence: audit firstTableTop=222; no hero. Search #q, type as role=tab strip (#tabs with counts), selects #fWh (Kho), #fStatus, #fCreator. Date range is only inside the 'Bộ lọc khác' popover (#morePanel), not directly visible. Screenshot first viewport is partly covered by an empty confirm dialog (see notes).

items.item: Movement type is shown as a text label combined with an icon or shape, not by colour alone, and the set of types is limited to receipt, issue, transfer and adjustment
items.evidence: TYPES = in/out/transfer/adjust with label + SVG icon in rowHtml ("Nhập kho", "Xuất kho", "Chuyển kho", "Điều chỉnh tồn"); icon is muted slate, text is always present.

items.item: Quantity changes carry an explicit + or − sign, are right-aligned with tabular figures, and the unit of measure is in the column header or a separate unit column, not repeated inside cells
items.evidence: signed() adds '+'/'-' (ASCII hyphen) but transfer rows show unsigned qty (qtyTxt=nf.format) and issue (out) quantities are generated positive so they render '+N', which misstates direction. Column 'Tổng số lượng' is a document-level total summed across lines with different units and has no unit in the header or a unit column. Audit numeric-align error x2: headers of columns 7 and 8 are not right-aligned (sort button inline-flex inside th.text-right). Cells do use .num tabular-nums and text-right.

items.item: A transfer row shows both the source and destination warehouse, and each row has a human-readable document number plus an absolute date and time
items.evidence: whc = `${wh} → ${wh2}` e.g. "Đà Nẵng → Hà Nội" in screenshot; doc ids like PX-02252, PC-00329 as links; fmtDT gives "04/11/2026 15:28".

items.item: A running balance or resulting on-hand quantity column is available so users can reconcile each movement
items.evidence: COLS = Mã phiếu, Loại phiếu, Thời gian, Kho, Đối tác/lý do, Tổng số lượng, Giá trị, Trạng thái. No balance / on-hand column anywhere, including the detail panel. The page models documents, not per-SKU movement lines.

items.item: The table is sorted by date, newest first, by default, with `aria-sort` on the sorted header and pagination at the bottom with a page-size control
items.evidence: D defaults sort:'time', dir:'desc'; renderHead sets aria-sort="descending" on Thời gian th (chevron shown in screenshot); #pager has select#size (25/50/100) labelled 'Số dòng mỗi trang', Trước/Sau and page numbers.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading skeleton and an error state with retry are also present
items.evidence: render(): total===0 branches: first-use 'Chưa có phiếu kho nào' + create button vs 'Không có phiếu nào khớp bộ lọc' + #clearAll2 'Xóa bộ lọc'; skeleton() with .sk rows and aria-busy; S.error branch with #retry 'Thử lại'. Error/empty only reachable via ?state= or the overflow menu.

items.item: Icon-only controls have accessible names, interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Most icon buttons are named (#btnMore aria-label, row menu aria-label, chip remove aria-label, #pClose). But audit icon-button-name error on button#dlgYes (no accessible name; empty and visible as a red square in the screenshot). Row and select-all checkboxes are h-4 w-4 (16px) below 24px. Audit contrast: 255 checked, none failing; smallTargets reported 0 by the audit.

notes: Real rendering bug: #dlgWrap uses class 'grid' and #panel uses class 'flex', which override the hidden attribute, so on load a blank confirm dialog (empty title/body, empty red button) sits centred over the table with a dim backdrop, and the detail panel is displayed as an empty white band at the right (visible x>880 in run-2.png). This blocks the first viewport and breaks the 'not obscured' intent; keyboard users also land behind a modal. No template tells observed: no gradients, glass, KPI tiles, greeting header, uppercase tracking, emoji icons, or hover lift; radii small (4/6/8), status badges use a restrained 5-tone set. Filters show status and creator instead of date range inline. Header text ('Lịch sử xuất nhập kho') is document history, and the table lists documents not per-SKU stock movements.
